content: Peterude Natomereta Nete Iesu Dawer
mizmiz 9 nosik 18-24
Nerut kerkerge, Iesu tebteb erkepasameirer. Ege memegle ko ge urder, ege eudi ge yabi nautmerda, “Nako legize detauteda kaka nete nali?”
Wige abi detagerda, “Kepkep legize detauteda mama Zone Baptaiso nali; a wader legize pe ikereda mama Elaiza nali; a wader legize pe detauteda mama au emeret peropeta nali ko ma idid akaida.”
Ege yabi nautmerda, “A wape nako pewa detauteda ka nete nali?” Peterude abi detagri, “Mama Agudira Keriso nali.”
Ege Iesude yabi kelarkelar daratagerda ko nole able mir waditauteda netat leem.
Ega yabi ko daratagerda, “Able Lera Werem e ya au asiasi wadigi, a Aule, a Kebi Kirim Merkem, a Aotale ya nole abi lagkak waurder. Abi ya waipitare, e neis a netat gergerge ya ko wayakai idid obai.”
Ege ga akaida gair le daratagerda ge ge urder, “Nete laglag karidoge watabakiamu, e nole tababu obakepwarwa, tababu tabara satauro wepwa gair gegerge, a kari wanarmirwa.
Netide laglag tabara idid wakur, e ya weumi: nete ya karim weumi e ya tabara idid watirpei.”
Able piripiri mokakalam 8 gerger barukdarda ge Iesude able lu daratautlare, ege Peteru, Zone a Zemis naisidare paserem ogidare erkepasamem.
Nade ga e erkepasameirer, abra op depigemelu a abra wali akaida mokakalam poni atkiredatkired perper.
Keserkeser neis le, Mose a Elaiza, ge daralei abi mir detagelei.
Wi batomerdariei yabi zoromide nadari, wige Iesui detagerlei nako abra ididira mop ya Yerusalemage waikereder muige Agudi mirapuge.
Peteru a nerut neis memegle wi ut nardeder, ege wi ekiamdare a Yesura zorom dasmerdare a neis le nakweireder abi kemem.

Nade able legize Iesui dikairetlei, Peterude abi ikailu, “Kirimle, e debele ike ki peki dale. Ki neis a netat mud akerdare, netat marim, netat Moseim a netat Elaizaim.” (E nole umerkak e nalu detauter.)
Nade ga e mena mir detauter, baz tikalu a abi mudide yabi natkamidare. Able memegle geumge bakerer ge yabi bazide nartidare.
Ege kodomir teosmeda bazlam, “Kara werem pedali, Kaka itutida. Abi asrawem!”
Nade ga kodomir esemuda, Yesu ga tebteb ikweireder. Ege memeglegize gumik ispilare a wi nole le daratagerda able kerkerge. Legize Iesui Detwagda Able Utebge Ge Samariage Irdireder
Maike ga dikereder abra kerker waditutida nade Iesui ya ko waigardi kotorem, ege tabara idoni detaurigda obakiamuda Ierusalemaem.
Ege mir aisisle kikem namarikdarda; wi bakiauda ge able utebge muige Samariage ko abim lu watidisirda.
Ege le ge turder nole Iesui opdipita ableglam e kei ikasereder Ierusalamaem.
Nade able neis memegle Zemisiba Zonei able mir asriei wige eutmeriei, “Ople, nako ma laglag nali ki ur dabgerei kotorlam watabu able le wanasare?”
Iesu bataurikda ge yabi nataperti, wige no bakiaudare nerut utebem.
Asiasi Able Lera Ge Iesui Irmirlare
Nawer ga wi gabge nakasirweretlare, ege kimiaride Iesui detagri, “Ka mari namirer nagedim ma nakasereder.”

Iesude ge abi ikaidari, “Sumes ebur uridli yaba sumesge uteb nagriwerteda, a aperdaraperdar ebur pe uridli yaba tabara pek darawerteda epe Lera Werem pedali abra nole tabara uteb dirdiredi ko weidi a ner wezi.
Iesu akaidari nerut kimiar detagri, “Ma kari tararmir.” Ege able kimiaride abi ikaidari, “Ople, ma kari kikem namarik ka nabakiamulu kara bab tatkobeilu.”
Ege Iesude abi detagri, “Eudlegize umele tababu tabara eud buai wanatkoblare. Mage bakiamu eosmer able mir Agudi Basalayara ebrered.”
Nerut kimiar ge akaidari, “Ople, Kaka yaka mari narmire, mage kari nakai ka nabakiamulu kara buai taramrare.”
Iesude eudige abi detagri, “Netiba pe nole tababu kemerkemer baiswereda taba dorgeem pe Agudi gedubge ikeredi e nole abkorep dali Agudi Basalayage.”
